lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Array of high-luminance circular pixel clusters organized into parallel horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank, with centroid spacing exhibiting relative uniformity.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs to form a discernible rectilinear grid across the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple longitudinal linear features exhibit a high-contrast vertical luminance gradient (light superiorly, shadow inferiorly) running parallel to the horizontal axis of the flank.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of small, high-luminance spots across its dorsal surface area.
